title: Mere Hussain Mujhe
body:
mere hussain mujhe karbala dikha dije
mai muztarib hoo mere dil ka gham mita dije
<<DIVIDER>>
bas apne dil mein ziyarat ki ilteja le kar
mai baitha rehta hoo tasweer e karbala le kar
fana mein baitha hoo mujhko baqa bana dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai jaanta hoo bahot kam naseeb hoo maula
mujhe hai ilm bahot hi ghareeb hoo maula
ye kam naseebi o ghurbat meri mita dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan pe barchiyan kha kar giray ali akbar
jahan pe rakha hai gehwara e ali asghar
maqam e akbar o asghar mujhe dikha dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kazmain o najaf dekhun saamara dekhun
jahan jahan mere maula hai wo jagah dekhun
ye ilteja hai ke zaayir mujhe bana dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ho sake mujhe ashoor par bula lije
ay mere mola as mujhe ye sharaf ata kije
ke karbalayi mere naam mein laga dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye chata hoo wahan ashk se wazoo mai karun
karun mai seena zani khoon ka bhi pursa doo
wahan ki khaak mein mera lahoo mila dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi baras ye mera intezaam ho maula
chalun mai shauq se paidal najaf se karbobala
mere qadam bhi rahe arsh par laga dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
zareeh e hazrat e abbas ko bhi choomun mai
dar e huzoor pe mashkeeze ko bhi dekhun mai
to rasta e kaf e abbas bhi dikha dije
mere hussain mujhe...
<<DIVIDER>>
dua hai majid o mukhtar ki mere maula
jo momineen na ziyarat pe jaa sake aaqa
sab hi ko zaayir e karbobala bana dije
mere hussain mujhe...
author: Majid Raza Abidi
